public_rationale: The limited infrastructure-financing condition is supported. The predicted difficulty attracting investors to OpenAI is not established. CNBC reports investor-initiated proposals, which weighs against treating all OpenAI fundraising as severely impaired, but the discussions were ongoing and were not shown to be a comparable private-credit financing effort. With no deadline and no decisive completed attempt, the forecast remains open.
limitations: Financing OpenAI directly differs from financing infrastructure that OpenAI will use.
Interest in an equity round does not establish the ease of raising private credit.
The qualitative threshold leaves room for reviewer disagreement.

our_interpretation: The target is OpenAI, as established by the surrounding discussion.
The forecast concerns substantial difficulty attracting investor capital through private-credit funds, not an absolute inability to raise any money.
The surrounding discussion of very large recurring financing needs supplies scale but does not create an exact numerical fundraising threshold.
Substantial difficulty means documented investor refusals, material shortfalls, unusual delays or major concessions needed to complete a relevant fundraising attempt.
The descriptions of management and competitive rank are not separate outcomes being assessed.
criteria.support_condition: After the data-center financing condition is established, a relevant OpenAI fundraising attempt through private-credit funds experiences documented substantial difficulty attracting investors.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the condition is established, a completed and comparably large OpenAI financing effort through private-credit funds has documented strong investor demand and proceeds promptly without material shortfalls or exceptional concessions.
